title: LibUsdOracle.getTokenPrice WSTETH branch drops lookback, always returns spot wstETH/USD
description: In getTokenPrice(token, lookback), the WETH branch (line 79) correctly forwards `lookback` to LibEthUsdOracle.getEthUsdPrice(lookback), but the WSTETH branch (line 84) hardcodes LibWstethUsdOracle.getWstethUsdPrice(0), discarding the caller-supplied lookback. Any caller asking for a TWAP wstETH price through getTokenPrice receives the instantaneous price instead. This is an independent dropped-lookback bug from OR-001 (different function, different token). getUsdPrice (line 56) does forward lookback for WSTETH, so the two sibling functions are inconsistent, confirming line 84 is an oversight, not intent.
impact: TWAP requests for wstETH via getTokenPrice silently return spot, removing the intended smoothing. The Uniswap V3 wstETH:ETH leg inside LibWstethEthOracle is AMM-based, so forcing its short FIFTEEN_MINUTES window (spot path) rather than the requested longer lookback weakens manipulation resistance for that token relative to what the caller asked for.

ite.intent: getTokenPrice(WSTETH, lookback) returns a wstETH price averaged over the requested lookback.
ite.technique: Line 84 passes the literal 0 instead of the `lookback` parameter, so the TWA window is always the spot/15-minute default.
ite.evasion: The adjacent WETH branch and the sibling getUsdPrice both forward lookback, masking the single hardcoded 0.

ice_chain.corrupted_state: return value of LibUsdOracle.getTokenPrice for WSTETH (spot returned when TWAP requested)
ice_chain.consumer_action: uses wstETH USD price for liquidity/pricing reads
